releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.22.5
releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.5

**Release Date:** October 22, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~81 PRs merged since v0.22.4 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `bf0203a794a`, the window since v0.22.4 contains **231 non-merge commits** across **804 changed files** (+35,212 / −17,885), **81 merged PRs** and **30 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Nous sign-in reworked (every sign-in is the plain device login, the free-tier guest hands over to your account, the result shows who signed in, connectors offer sign-in instead of opening a guest), `hermes update` holding back a stable release it refuses instead of offering it, Windows `hermes update` no longer stuck on the old launcher after a Python repin, usage-window plan support (plan gauges, limit cards and model-switch recovery for window-based plans), pluggable delegation backends (route subagents by model map or profile, switchable per session), plugin slash commands that can ask you to pick an option, `hermes import-agent`, OpenClaw migration, `hermes mcp serve` and the Singularity backend moving out of core into plugins (setup offers the importer when it finds another agent), Desktop drag-to-pin in the sidebar and one-click plugin installs with tier badges, the Electron 44 upgrade, Pillow 13 and a batch of dependency security bumps, a clear message when a chat's working folder is gone, `hermes update` recovering paused gateways after a damaged `.git`, long Claude DirectSDK answers no longer cut off by the stall timer, Desktop group chats showing which bot is working again, and the experimental webhook-mode MCP events client.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.4...v0.22.5](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.4...v0.22.5)

releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.22.4
releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.4

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

> Patch release. Desktop stops showing suggestion pills above the composer, plus small plugin and dashboard fixes, for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## Fixes

- **Desktop no longer shows suggestion pills above the composer.** The pills appeared for no clear reason, mostly nudging you to set up MCP servers. They and the helpers that only they used are gone. ([#142559](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142559))
- **Plugins that install nothing skip the dependency consent step.** A plugin that declares no dependencies, or whose `pyproject.toml` installs nothing, now enables without an empty consent prompt. ([#142569](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142569))
- **Dashboard: WhatsApp can be safely re-paired after logging out.** ([#142439](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142439))
- **Desktop plugin review:** the surface lint no longer flags prototype writes; reviewers check them by hand. ([#142586](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142586))
- **Desktop: the approval-mode chip follows the active profile's mode.** ([#142565](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142565))
- **Release builds:** the desktop bundle's pre-build check gets enough time to verify archived build inputs when storage is slow. ([#142623](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142623))

Also new in the plugin catalog: bubblewrap (bwrap terminal backend on Linux), Singularity/Apptainer, mcp-serve (Hermes as an MCP server), agent-importers (`hermes import-agent`, now with Cursor), inbox and workflow-record from Hermes Labs. Telegram Business moves to the Hermes Labs community tier.

## About this release

Measured at commit `4d04303818b`, the window since v0.22.3 contains **14 non-merge commits** across **82 changed files** (+1,475 / −3,022) and **13 merged PRs**.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.3...v0.22.4](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.3...v0.22.4)

releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.2

**Release Date:** October 15, 2026

v0.22.1 was built from the wrong commit. It shipped unreleased gateway work, and the Microsoft Store app could stick on "Connecting." 0.22.2 is the release 0.22.1 was meant to be.

> **Known issue:** Sessions that ran under the 0.22.1 gateway can't be deleted in 0.22.2.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## Highlights

- **The gateway starts after a reboot again.** After a restart, Linux can hand an early PID to an unrelated process, and the gateway could mistake it for a running gateway, so a supervised gateway (systemd, launchd, Docker) refused to start. Hermes now records the boot it started in, and when it can't tell, it asks the host lock, which only a live gateway holds. ([#138594](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138594), fixes [#133744](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/133744))
- **Long local-model turns survive on laptops.** Local requests always stream with prompt-reading progress (shown in the status line), stall timers skip time the machine was asleep, a recovered local server gets another try instead of a breaker that failed every later message, and compression no longer times out while the server is still reading a long conversation. On Windows unified-memory machines, model launch and the prompt cache are sized to free memory. ([#138560](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138560))

Below is everything in the 0.22 release line since v0.22.0: the fixes 0.22.1 was meant to ship, plus the two above. Work that is only on `main` ships with v0.23.0.

releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.22.0 — The Threshold Release
releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.0

**Release Date:** October 13, 2026
**Since v0.21.0:** ~24,200 commits · ~6,080 merged PRs · ~15,600 files changed · ~2,045,000 insertions · ~1,140,000 deletions · **~7,180 issues closed** · ~2,520 contributors

> **The Threshold Release.** Hermes was the god of thresholds: the doorway, the crossing, the boundary stone. v0.21.0 assembled the pantheon; v0.22.0 is about getting through the door. A fresh desktop install now opens on a guided setup chat that runs on a free trial model, so a newcomer is talking to Hermes before they own an API key. Connectors carry the agent across into the apps you already use, with no account needed to start. Local models bring it home to your own hardware with a one-click llama.cpp runtime. And the threshold itself got sturdier: tested SemVer stable releases that installs follow by default, signed desktop packages (including the Microsoft Store), and one package manager underneath everything. Around that spine: a 600-plugin catalog, the Claude 5.5 / GPT-6 model wave, password-manager sign-in for the browser, a bot screen you can take over, one backend and one gateway for every profile, and a codebase a third smaller. This is the largest window Hermes has shipped, about 2.5x the v0.21.0 cycle, and it rolls up and fully documents the v0.21.1–v0.21.7 patch releases.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **A first launch that sets itself up** — Open the desktop app on a computer where you have never used Hermes and it starts a short setup chat instead of a settings screen. One card at a time it asks your name, an accent color and a layout, which apps to connect, which plugins to install, then gives a quick tour and offers up to four first tasks picked for you. It runs on a free trial model (`nous/welcome`, once per OS user), so it needs no key; **Skip setup** ends it and **Settings → Run onboarding again** brings it back. The agent also gained `set_theme`, so "make it violet, dark mode" works in any desktop chat. ([#137429](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137429), [#137522](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137522), [#137807](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137807), [#134209](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134209), [#105258](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105258) — @alt-glitch, @OutThisLife, @ethernet8023, @rewbs)

- **Connectors: Hermes works inside your apps** — The agent can now act in hosted apps such as Linear and Notion through the Nous tool gateway: ask for an app, sign in once in your browser, and the tools are usable in the same turn. You do not need a Nous account to start; the first time you use an app, Hermes creates a free connectors-only identity. The desktop has a new **Connectors** page that puts hosted apps and your MCP servers in one list (it replaces the MCP tab), the same setup card appears in the TUI and CLI, and you can connect several named accounts of one app (a `work` and a `home` account) and manage them with `/connectors` or `hermes connectors`. ([#106842](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106842), [#111008](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111008), [#119074](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/119074), [#135143](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135143), [#135072](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135072), [#135097](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135097), [#135151](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135151), [#135173](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135173), [#137426](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137426) — @alt-glitch, @rewbs)

- **Local models in one click** — Hermes can now run open models entirely on your machine with nothing leaving it: no account, no API key. It installs and maintains llama.cpp with the right engine for your hardware (CPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan or ROCm), rates every catalog model against your GPU and RAM, and picks the highest-quality build that fits. Downloads pause and resume, the server starts and stops with Hermes, and engine updates are one click. Start from **Settings → Providers → Local Models** on Windows, macOS and Linux, or `hermes model` → **Local models** in a terminal. The catalog includes Qwen3.8 27B, Qwen3.8 Flash Next (with its MTP speculative head), Qwen3.6 35B-A3B and DeepSeek V4 Flash, plus any GGUF from Hugging Face. ([#100667](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100667), [#101823](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101823), [#128768](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/128768), [#111423](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111423), [#133111](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133111), [#134116](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134116) — @jquesnelle, @ethernet8023)

- **Stable release channels** — Hermes now ships tested SemVer releases. Every release passes source CI, Docker, Nix, signed desktop builds and install/upgrade runs on every OS before it is published, and source installs now move from release to release by default instead of tracking every commit on `main`. Prefer the bleeding edge? `hermes update --set-channel main`, or the new channel switch in Desktop **Settings → About**. Moving to an older release is labelled a rollback and never happens without asking, and installer reruns keep you on the channel you chose. ([#102765](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/102765), [#135847](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135847), [#135949](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135949), [#136313](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136313), [#137780](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137780) — @ethernet8023, @KoNit-K)

- **Signed desktop packages, the Microsoft Store, and one package manager** — The desktop app is now a sealed, signed package that carries its own Python and Node and updates itself, so first launch builds nothing. Windows gets a signed MSIX (x64 and ARM64) through App Installer or the Microsoft Store; macOS gets a signed, notarized build for Apple Silicon. Underneath, a new unified package manager (`hermes pm`) owns every pinned, hash-checked tool and Python environment: updates build a new environment and switch only once it passes its check, so a failed or killed update can no longer leave you half-applied. ([#102765](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/102765), [#132361](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132361), [#132386](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132386), [#120339](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/120339), [#122221](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122221) — @ethernet8023)


- **The Plugin Catalog: 600 reviewed plugins** — The plugin catalog launched this cycle and grew to 600 entries, each pinned to a reviewed commit and installable from Hermes Desktop or the CLI. Browse by category and star ranking with a page per plugin and per author; catalog rules keep listed plugins from patching Hermes internals or shipping unscannable binaries. Memory providers now live with their makers (Honcho, Supermemory, Hindsight, Mem0, OpenViking, Holographic), as do Home Assistant, Spotify and Langfuse: existing users are migrated automatically, and the default install got leaner. ([#69446](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/69446), [#111415](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111415), [#117808](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/117808), [#113381](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113381), [#114732](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/114732), [#131267](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131267), [#132476](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132476), [#136436](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136436) — @itpartypattaya, @happy5318, and 400+ plugin authors)

- **The Claude 5.5 and GPT-6 model wave** — Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna plus GPT-6.1 Sol, and Gemini 4 Argon are pickable on Nous Portal, OpenRouter and native routes where offered. Prior reasoning is now replayed by default on every provider that can read it, across resume, branches and compaction, so long multi-step work keeps its train of thought. And when a provider has a bad hour, Hermes waits out transient 503/529/timeouts in visible, bounded cycles instead of ending your turn. ([#100577](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100577), [#119304](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/119304), [#126842](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126842), [#134759](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134759), [#128248](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/128248), [#137955](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137955), [#136358](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136358), [#116353](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/116353) — @kshitijk4poor, @unsupportedpastels, @100yenadmin, @mssteuer, @xxxigm)

- **Sign in to websites with your password manager** — The browser agent can log into sites with logins from 1Password, Bitwarden or Hermes's own encrypted vault, and the model never sees the password. If nothing is saved, you get a masked prompt in the CLI, TUI or Desktop to save it, one-time codes are filled without entering the conversation, and card and address fills at checkout need your confirmation. ([#106480](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106480), [#107585](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/107585), [#137084](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137084))

- **Bot Screen: watch your bot work, take over when it needs you** — A bot running on a Linux gateway can have its own desktop that Hermes Desktop streams live. When it hits a login, a 2FA prompt or a CAPTCHA, you take the screen, finish the step yourself, and hand control back while the bot carries on with your session. With a Docker, SSH or Singularity backend, the bot's screen, computer use and the browser run inside the sandbox, never on your host. ([#108914](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/108914), [#121169](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/121169), [#121110](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/121110))

- **One backend and one gateway for every profile** — Hermes now runs a single messaging gateway and a single desktop backend per machine that serve all of your profiles, instead of one process per profile. Creating a profile makes its bots live without a restart, each profile keeps its own credentials, allowlists, cron jobs and sessions, and `hermes update` migrates existing per-profile setups automatically. Fewer processes, no token clashes, one thing to start and stop. ([#112854](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112854), [#108928](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/108928), [#118273](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118273), [#117983](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/117983), [#118246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118246), [#118027](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118027))

- **See and steer your subagents live** — Running subagents now stay visible above the composer in the CLI (F6), TUI (Ctrl+T) and Desktop with each child's task, elapsed time and live transcript, plus Steer and Stop buttons. `/stop` reaches background children and hands back their partial work, and `delegate_task` can pass screenshots and mocks to vision-capable children. ([#105593](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105593), [#115616](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/115616), [#97689](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97689))

- **A model picker that knows your plans** — Star your favorite models, see a subscription running low ("17% left · resets 3:00 PM") and when a rate limit lifts right in the picker, and pick reasoning effort as part of choosing a model in `hermes model`, `/model` (`/model X --reasoning high`) and Desktop. You switch before you hit the wall instead of after. ([#126535](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126535), [#133392](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133392), [#133408](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133408), [#110346](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/110346), [#113117](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113117) — @OutThisLife, @anotherchu)

- **Hermes in your language, everywhere** — Every user-facing string in the CLI, messaging gateway, TUI and Desktop now goes through one translation catalog with full coverage in all 16 bundled languages. New languages can ship as plugins, and any profile can override individual strings with a small YAML file. ([#126296](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126296))

- **Leaner in every sense** — The whole codebase was simplified with zero behavior change: source went from about 1.06M to 698K lines (−34%) and `gateway/run.py` shrank from 34,847 lines to 5,512. Prompts got lighter too: about 19 rarely used tools now load only when the agent searches for them, roughly halving the desktop tool schema sent on every call, and another ~2.1k tokens came off the fixed prompt. Local models prefill less on every turn. ([#102117](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/102117), [#97979](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97979), [#106676](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106676), [#137084](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137084) — @alt-glitch)

- **Small comforts that add up** — Opt-in vim keys in the CLI prompt, a git-branch field in the status bar, a bell and desktop notification when Hermes is waiting on you, Ctrl+C that clears your draft instead of killing the turn, an editable `/queue`, and `hermes --native` to let your own terminal handle TUI scrollback and search. On Desktop, a new **Simple** mode turns the app into a plain chat window, and errors now say what went wrong with a one-click fix. ([#106412](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106412), [#106434](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106434), [#101284](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101284), [#101320](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101320), [#137065](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137065), [#95999](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/95999), [#121035](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/121035), [#118587](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118587), [#111601](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111601) — @saforem2, @TurgutKural, @glitchbunny0, @harshmoney123, @pierrenode, @abhinav11082001-stack, @OutThisLife)

---

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Python 3.14 is the runtime** for managed installs (the package manager installs it for you). KittenTTS is unavailable on 3.14. ([#102765](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/102765))
- **Windows desktop is MSIX-only** and needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer; the NSIS/MSI installers are gone. The macOS app is Apple Silicon only in default builds. ([#102765](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/102765), [#136603](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136603))
- **One gateway per machine is the default.** `hermes update` folds per-profile gateways into the multiplexed default when nothing conflicts. ([#112854](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112854))
- **Chats no longer reset on an idle/daily timer.** `session_reset` idle/daily modes are retired (configs that still set them log a warning); `/new` or `/reset` starts fresh. ([#105021](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105021), [#126244](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126244))
- **Old sessions are pruned automatically.** `sessions.auto_prune` now defaults to on: ended sessions inactive for 90 days are deleted at startup. Pinned and open sessions are never touched; set `sessions.auto_prune: false` to keep everything.
- **Memory providers moved to catalog plugins** (Honcho, Supermemory, Hindsight, Mem0, OpenViking, Holographic), as did Home Assistant, Spotify and Langfuse. Existing users are migrated on update or first start, with data intact. ByteRover and RetainDB remain bundled.
- **Plugin authors:** the old plugin compatibility import layer is gone ([#126164](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126164)), `hermes sync` (Skill Sync) was removed ([#132465](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132465)), and the bundled tirith scanner was removed ([#133832](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133832)). Several tools were renamed (`todo` → `todo_list`, `cronjob` → `cronjob_manage`, `process` → `process_manage`); the old names still work. ([#97979](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97979))

## 📦 Stable Releases, Desktop Packages & Package Manager

### Stable releases & update channels
- **Tested SemVer stable releases and the channel switch** *(see Highlights)*. v0.21.6 and v0.21.7 were the first through the new gate; forks stay on `main`, and an install ahead of the newest release waits for the next.

### Desktop bundles & the Microsoft Store
- **Sealed, signed desktop packages** *(see Highlights)*. In a package, `hermes update` points to the right updater (App Installer, Store or macOS). ([#134911](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134911))

### Unified package manager
- **`hermes pm`** *(see Highlights)*: pinned, hash-checked Python 3.14, uv, Node, ripgrep, FFmpeg, Chromium and Git/Bash on Windows, with `hermes pm doctor|status|repair|gc`. Contributors use `source ./activate` (or `.ps1`/`.fish`).
- **Dependency environments are generations** — new ones are checked before use, so a failed install keeps the working one; updates and `hermes pm gc` reclaim old ones (92 GB to 18 GB on one host). ([#124968](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/124968), [#133808](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133808) — @JoaoMarcos44)
- **Optional features install on first use** — opt-in SDKs (Anthropic, Bedrock) load mid-session without a restart; `security.allow_lazy_installs: false` turns this off. ([#122221](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122221) — @ethernet8023)
- **Plugins declare Python dependencies** — resolved with core across profiles; conflicts are refused, and updates disable a plugin that no longer fits. Hindsight, Honcho, Supermemory, Mem0 and Home Assistant moved to the catalog and auto-install where used. ([#113851](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113851), [#122103](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122103), [#114569](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/114569), [#132469](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132469) — @ethernet8023)

### Install & update
- **Updates can't half-apply** *(see Highlights)*. A killed update repairs itself on the next launch. ([#132361](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132361), [#120339](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/120339))
- **Faster updates, smaller checkouts** — updates rebuild only what changed (16.5 s vs 32.5 s on macOS), clones are blobless, and partial-clone `.git` growth is fixed. ([#135092](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135092), [#133016](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133016), [#131679](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131679) — @kshitijk4poor, @ethernet8023, @liuhao1024, @whyyagswhy)
- **Small, hash-checked installers** — `install.sh`/`install.ps1` verify pinned uv and Git, hand off to PM, log to `logs/install.log`, and now work on musl Linux (Alpine, Void), Windows 10 and Unicode Windows paths. ([#124964](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/124964), [#125598](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125598), [#132430](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132430) — @JoaoMarcos44, @kshitijk4poor, @Finn763, @OutThisLife)
- **Failures say why** — with opt-in telemetry, install, update, skill and plugin failures record a reason. ([#133809](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133809))

### Docker / Nix / Termux / Windows
- **Docker** — pinned Debian 13 base with full Chromium; `stable`/`latest` move only on a published release; baked-in extras return after a restart. ([#135726](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135726), [#135084](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135084) — @unsupportedpastels)

([#128144](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/128144), [#122146](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122146), [#131779](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131779) — @ethernet8023, @janviernine)

### CI & release engineering
- **Release gates** — E2E suites run on release builds, the full suite on native Windows, and SSH/Docker backends against real daemons. ([#135409](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/135409), [#96458](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/96458), [#136602](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136602) — @ethernet8023)

## 🏗️ Core Agent, Sessions & Memory

### Agent loop & reliability
- **Stalled turns recover** — a watchdog (`agent.turn_liveness.timeout_s`, default 600 s) interrupts a no-progress turn and frees its session; repeated transcript repairs now raise one error and notice. ([#99758](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/99758), [#99687](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/99687) — @kshitijk4poor, @Finn763, @HexLab98)
- **Streams fail less and report honestly** — text-less dead streams retry, repetition loops are cut, and interrupted turns aren't reported as done. ([#113135](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113135), [#130551](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/130551), [#112272](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112272) — @kshitijk4poor)

### Compression & context
- **Compaction triggers on real token counts** — provider-reported usage, not bytes/4; the protected tail is capped at 20% so small-window models compact. ([#104555](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/104555), [#117957](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/117957) — @686f6c61)
- **Bad summaries can't wipe context** — refusals and overloaded summary providers leave the transcript alone, and an uncommitted compaction changes nothing. ([#118920](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118920), [#115906](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/115906), [#136083](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136083) — @kshitijk4poor, @fangliquanflq, @mnajafian-nv)
- **New knobs** — provider-scoped `compression.model_thresholds` keys and `auxiliary.<task>.no_progress_timeout`. ([#108061](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/108061), [#115804](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/115804) — @chelsealong)

### Sessions & state.db
- **state.db reliability** — lock timeouts name the holding process, a busy database no longer kills a turn, and sibling PID namespaces can't steal leases. ([#116967](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/116967), [#134577](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134577), [#132161](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132161) — @kshitijk4poor, @686f6c61)
- **state.db stops growing** — auto-prune is on by default (ended sessions over 90 days) and closes stale cron/kanban/subagent sessions; VACUUM runs only when 25% is reclaimable. ([#101316](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101316), [#100903](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100903) — @stepanov1975)
- **Repair commands** — `hermes sessions set-journal-mode delete|wal`, `repair-profiles` (crossed profiles) and `repair-prompts`. ([#117684](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/117684), [#115689](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/115689), [#124200](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/124200) — @kshitijk4poor, @JoaoMarcos44)
- **Cleaner session lists** — one-shot runs stay out of pickers, `sessions.show_subagents` lists titled subagent chats, messages get stable ids for context engines. ([#113826](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113826), [#122304](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122304), [#126687](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126687) — @OutThisLife, @kshitijk4poor, @100yenadmin)

### Memory
- **Memory providers leave core safely** — OpenViking and Holographic move to the plugin catalog on update or first start, data intact, or say why not. ([#134350](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134350), [#136436](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136436), [#131269](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131269))
- **Built-in memory writes land** — hand-formatted MEMORY.md/USER.md accepted, refusals say what to fix, secrets scrubbed before providers see them. ([#133038](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133038), [#134429](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134429) — @aniruddhaadak80)

### Profiles & config
- **config.yaml survives bad moments** — a broken file falls back to the last good copy; read errors can't wipe it. ([#109463](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/109463), [#120343](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/120343) — @Shenrui-Ma, @huklaa)
- **Safer `hermes config`** — `get` masks secrets (`--raw` opts out); `set` refuses typo paths and stores env-style names in `.env`. ([#111341](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111341), [#112250](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112250) — @webtecnica)
- **Profiles stay separate** — REST routes act on the profile they name, exports skip `.ssh`/`.aws`/`.gnupg`, and `import-agent --sync` keeps imports current. ([#118275](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118275), [#132201](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132201), [#88855](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88855) — @kshitijk4poor, @JerryLiu369)

### Languages (i18n)
- **Language packs** — any language can ship as a plugin (`provides_locales`) or a per-profile override file. ([#126296](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/126296))

- **One gateway serves every profile** — `hermes gateway status` explains any boot-guard refusal, `hermes gateway migrate --multiplex` migrates by hand, webhook platforms serve each profile at `/p/<profile>/`, `hermes -p X gateway stop|start` parks one profile, and `gateway.standalone: true` is a temporary opt-out. ## 🔧 Tools, MCP & Browser

### Tools & tool search
- **Rare tools load on demand** — computer_use, session_search, image_generate, cron and Desktop GUI tools sit behind `tool_search` by default (desktop schemas 13,367→6,883 tokens; `defer: []` opts out); `todo`/`cronjob`/`process` become `todo_list`/`cronjob_manage`/`process_manage` (aliases kept). - **Prompt cache holds all session** — the tool list is frozen per session across TUI, `-q --resume` and gateway hops. ([#120289](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/120289))
- **Loop guardrails** — unattended gateway/cron sessions hard-stop tool loops; 5 identical replays halt any tool. ([#100967](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100967) — @plcunha, @benbenlijie)
- **Smarter file and web tools** — `read_file` shows SQLite schemas and flags merge conflicts, `search_files` runs ripgrep directly (5–6x faster), keyless `web_search` fails over between free vendors. - **Sturdier OAuth** — refresh tokens are never erased, double-spent or sent to another issuer; RFC 9207, Google-hosted and WAF-fronted servers log in; gateways never open browser tabs. ## ⏰ Cron, Kanban & Delegation

### Cron
- **Jobs follow your main model** — Unpinned jobs use the model configured at fire time; `pinned` locks one. ([#113679](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113679))
- **Self-healing schedules** — A fire that never reached the model (e.g. after wake) re-runs after 5, 15 and 30 minutes, a provider "retry after" window parks the job quietly, and a slot missed during a restart fires once. ([#108731](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/108731), [#115843](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/115843))
- **Quieter alerts** — One alert per incident plus a reminder every `cron.failure_repeat_alert_hours`; `failure_deliver` reroutes or mutes failure notices; an agent can fail its run with `[CRON_FAILURE]`. ([#114807](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/114807), [#101373](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101373), [#113155](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113155)) — @victor-kyriazakos
- **New job options** — `--paused` creates a job unarmed; `--interpreter` runs scripts on your own venv. ([#104984](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/104984), [#125392](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125392)) — @M1racleShih
- **Profiles and delivery** — A multiplexed gateway runs each profile's jobs with that profile's env and secrets; delivery needs positive evidence, output is secret-redacted everywhere, and late or satellite runs are labelled. ([#118027](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118027), [#100908](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100908), [#112830](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112830)) — @yoniebans

### Kanban
- **Workers ride out provider trouble** — Failed turns retry in place with context; rate limits or 5xx requeue instead of burning retries. ([#112318](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112318), [#112500](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112500)) — @EvgenyMettsler, @dmelkk-secondbrain
- **A board that explains itself** — Cards show the worker's last output on failure; dispatch says why a card is held. ([#112618](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112618)) — @chelsealong
- **Workflow and tooling** — One workflow definition drives columns; workers get `kanban_schedule`; `kanban create --body-file`; Desktop follows gateway switches. ([#134340](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134340), [#130455](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/130455), [#116791](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/116791), [#119054](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/119054)) — @benbarclay, @unsupportedpastels, @fangliquanflq

### Delegation & multi-agent
- **Live subagents, images and /stop** *(see Highlights)*. ([#105593](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105593))
- **Fan-outs lose less** — Failed children surface at once, an owner crash keeps finished work, children can hand processes to the parent, and per-task completions are opt-in. ([#103549](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/103549), [#116707](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/116707), [#105125](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105125))
- **Child routing** — `delegation.fallback_providers` gives children their own chain; `child_timeout_seconds` measures inactivity. ([#105347](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/105347), [#117606](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/117606)) — @ayushnangia
- **/goal** — Consistent on CLI, Desktop and messaging; the judge waits on subagents; `/goal pause for now` no longer overwrites the goal; gates run in the session workspace. ([#104833](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/104833), [#132251](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132251), [#125453](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125453)) — @jayzhou2309

## 🔒 Security, Privacy & Codebase

### Security & privacy
- **v0.21.6 security fixes** — dashboard sign-in hardening (spoofed `X-Forwarded-For`, size caps, loopback-only login codes); automatic git skips repo filter programs; the email allowlist resists display-name spoofing. ([#133367](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133367), [#130685](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/130685), [#130661](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/130661), [#125212](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125212)) — @unsupportedpastels, @kshitijk4poor, @Froraut, @jonpol01, @keeltrace
- **Secrets stay put** — child processes don't inherit adapter/dashboard secrets; remote `execute_code` keeps its token out of argv; profile exports skip credential stores; keys never reach foreign hosts on refresh/fallback. ([#125755](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125755), [#124262](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/124262), [#130525](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/130525), [#120299](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/120299)) — @kshitijk4poor, @jonpol01, @beardthelion, @leemove
- **Sharper redaction** — debug share redacts before truncating; file reads and terminal output mask `.env`/config secrets; `hermes config get` masks unless `--raw`; memory hand-offs are scrubbed; plain `token=` lines stay visible. ([#132270](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/132270), [#111422](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111422), [#111341](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/111341), [#134429](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/134429), [#100564](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/100564)) — @kshitijk4poor, @Froraut, @shehjaddev, @webtecnica, @aniruddhaadak80, @fangliquanflq
- **Owner-only files at rest** — credentials, `state.db`, snapshots, browser profiles, media caches, any umask. ([#109509](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/109509), [#127229](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/127229)) — @JoaoMarcos44, @rohitsabu, @OutThisLife
- **Wider guards** — more fetches pass the SSRF guard (`security.fake_ip_ranges` for fake-ip proxies); cloud-metadata fetches, zsh/dash pipe-to-shell and `deno eval` need approval; `approvals.deny` works in sandboxes; built-in rules replace bundled tirith. ([#114887](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/114887), [#113156](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/113156), [#116726](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/116726), [#103649](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/103649), [#133832](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133832)) — @beardthelion, @AYin-Z, @fangliquanflq
- **Holes closed** — the MCP OAuth callback stops reflecting HTML; webhook, SMS and WhatsApp Cloud inbound reject blank signing secrets. ([#92612](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/92612), [#133257](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/133257)) — @memosr, @ahadvice
- **Opt-in shared metrics** — daily usage stats reach Nous only with consent; both `telemetry.shared_metrics` switches default off, each profile asks once, Enter = "No thanks". ([#95278](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/95278)) — @benbarclay
### Codebase & performance
- **Leaner prompts and tools** — ~2.1k fewer prompt tokens a request, on-demand vault tools, one-round-trip file probes, `hermes -w` no longer repacks each launch. ([#137084](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137084), [#101599](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101599)) — @yaojiejia
### Other
- **Safer backups** — `hermes backup` keeps the newest 3, flags incomplete archives; `hermes import` refuses damaged ones. ([#106455](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106455), [#121498](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/121498)) — @buihongduc132, @kshitijk4poor
- **Also** — `KEY_2`… env vars join credential pools; one-screen `hermes status`; opt-in `display.suppress_warning_notifications`; Desktop Bots roster sections; only Hermes' own node/npm/uv are used; Xiaomi MiMo v2.6. ([#112390](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/112390), [#131034](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131034), [#114370](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/114370), [#101290](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/101290), [#125589](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/125589), [#118502](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118502)) — @PhoeniXAbhisheK, @victor-kyriazakos, @fortun8te, @rob-maron
- **For contributors** — CODEOWNERS replaces the label gate; E2E (incl. native Windows) runs only on release builds; stable releases skip macOS Intel/Termux by default. ([#131726](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/131726), [#136603](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/136603)) — @ethernet8023

releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.21.7
releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.21.7

**Release Date:** October 11, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~204 PRs merged since v0.21.6 into a stable release for the desktop app (macOS Apple silicon, Windows), the Microsoft Store and MSIX, the installer, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.22.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

**What this patch ships for source installs (`hermes update` and the desktop app's updater on a git checkout):**

- **Updates now follow tagged releases.** A source install of the official repository updates to the latest published `vX.Y.Z` release instead of every commit on `main`. An install already newer than the latest release stays where it is and waits for the next one; nothing is moved back. To keep following every commit: `hermes update --set-channel main`. Forks and mirrors keep following `main`. Store, MSIX and bundled desktop installs are unchanged.
- **Choose the channel in the desktop app.** Settings ▸ About ▸ Updates has an *Update channel* switch (Stable releases / Every commit) for source installs, and the update dialog now shows which channel you are on.
- **Reasoning survives resume.** Signed thinking replays after `hermes chat --resume` and on the next gateway turn, and Bedrock Converse reasoning models no longer get rejected on resumed sessions.
- **Updates no longer fail behind some firewalls.** Installs on `main` no longer fetch a release record that regional firewalls could answer with 403. The stable check uses your GitHub token when one is set (`GITHUB_TOKEN` or `gh auth login`) and reports a GitHub rate limit as a rate limit.

## About this release

Measured at commit `1fd18277267152893a8a24792b79213e7ca3f899`, the window since v0.21.6 contains **740 non-merge commits** across **4,156 changed files** (+86,775 / −26,980), **204 merged PRs** and **69 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: plugins running built-in Desktop app actions (`ctx.runAction`) and a plugin SDK pet bubble (`ctx.pet.say`); core-made Codex requests so plugins never hold the token; skills installed mid-session reaching the model without a prompt rebuild; Krea 2 Medium Turbo as the default image lane for new paid subscribers, with a FAL fallback when managed Krea refuses a request; faster desktop updates (the React Compiler pass cached by content, the compiled renderer reused when only the install stamp changed, unchanged native inputs left in place); pinned installs that check out only the pin; compaction marks emitted to Relay; and new community plugins including memory-shield, command-ledger, Memoria, Model Router, wyoming-voice-bridge, codex-account-switch and redline.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.22.0**, which will document everything from v0.21.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Desktop app: updates itself. Microsoft Store installs update through the Store.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.21.6...v0.21.7](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.21.6...v0.21.7)

releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.21.6
releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.21.6

**Release Date:** October 8, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~2,100 PRs merged since v0.21.5 into a stable tagged release for Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.22.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

This is the first release cut by the new stable release pipeline: one attempt ref, a tested Docker image, and a receipt tag at publish. It ships the tag, this GitHub release and the Docker image. The desktop app, Termux packages and the Microsoft Store stay on their current build for now and move with the next bundled release.

Measured at commit `818c13be1dc4fd28987e1e881a9408224afd4535`, the window since v0.21.5 contains **8,867 non-merge commits** across **8,342 changed files** (+772,490 / −225,600), **2,106 merged PRs** and **3,027 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: live transcription while you speak on CLI, TUI and Desktop (`stt.streaming`); spoken voice turns routed to their own model (`auxiliary.voice_chat`) with reasoning off by default; third-party plugins running in a per-profile plugin host (`plugins.isolation: host`) and one Settings ▸ Plugins home for their settings pages; favorite and pinned models at the top of the Desktop picker, a usage chip before a subscription hits its wall, and rate-limited providers that say why and until when; local models in `hermes model` plus llama.cpp CUDA on Linux x64 and arm64; pluggable, layered language packs across core, Desktop and TUI; a summary-first `hermes status` (`--short`, `--full`); a review-pane diff scope selector (Uncommitted / Branch / Last turn) and keep-awake that follows the turn; cron, `doctor` and home-channel warnings when the cron store goes unwritable; approval flags for credential uploads and invisible Unicode in terminal commands; a Discord setup that checks the bot token and prints the invite link; a unified Kanban workflow definition; `activate.fish`; GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 in the catalogs; and dozens of new community plugins.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.22.0**, which will document everything from v0.21.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).
- CLI (git installs): `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Desktop app and Termux: no change in this release; they update with the next bundled release.

## Security Fixes

**Dashboard authentication hardening**

- Spoofed `X-Forwarded-For` headers could reset the password-login rate limit and get around the per-IP cap on native sign-in (#133367)
- Unauthenticated login requests could write unbounded values to the auth audit log (#133369)
- The public `/auth/` routes had no request-body size limit (#133370)
- Native sign-in could send login codes to a non-loopback redirect, which allowed session takeover (#130685)

Thanks to Tenable Research for reporting all four issues (TRA-725, TRA-726, TRA-727, TRA-728). The native sign-in redirect issue was also reported independently and fixed by @Froraut. The `X-Forwarded-For` fix builds on community work by @hinotoi-agent and @BearHuddleston (#40285).

**Repository git filter hardening**

- Automatic git calls (session workspace snapshot, subagent worktrees, kanban, worktree cleanup, `hermes -w`) could run `clean`/`smudge`/`process` filter programs defined by an untrusted repository's own config, before the first prompt (#130661)

Thanks to 燕涛 for reporting this privately. It was also reported and fixed publicly by @jonpol01 (#126017, #126019) and @JoaoMarcos44 (#126075).

**Email gateway sender hardening**

- A quoted display name in the `From` header (e.g. `"Victim <victim@example.com>" <attacker@evil.test>`) could make an attacker's message pass the email allowlist as an allowed sender (#125212)

Thanks to Daniel Steele (@keeltrace) for reporting this and writing the fix (#124322).


**Full Changelog**: [v2026.9.24...v0.21.6](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v2026.9.24...v0.21.6)

# Hermes Agent v0.21.5 (v2026.9.24)

**Release Date:** September 24, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~460 PRs merged since v0.21.4 into a stable tagged release for downstream consumers (Docker images, Hermes Cloud, hosted deployments). Full curated notes for this window are deferred to v0.22.0.

## What this patch ships for remote Desktop / Cloud users

- **Remote dashboard sessions no longer expire on refresh bursts** (#110061, fixes #55712; salvage #71548 @Doud-FR, #55717 @liuhao1024). releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.21.2 (v2026.9.11) — The state.db Patch Release

**Release Date:** September 11, 2026

> Patch release. v0.21.0 shipped a large rewrite of the session store's connection handling, and for some installs it made `state.db` fragile: second writers cancelling each other's locks, healthy databases reported as corrupt, one bad row killing `sessions list`. This release closes that class and rolls up everything else that landed on `main` in the four days since v0.21.1.

## About this release

Measured at commit `04dd80a977f40b05e5b2054111747af07a61886a`, the window since v0.21.1 contains **947 non-merge commits** across **1,869 changed files** (+182,504 / −15,564) and **312 merged PRs**. **140 contributors** appear in commits, co-author trailers, or salvage credits.

## ✨ Highlights

### state.db reliability campaign (six PRs, 44 issues closed)

If your `state.db` broke after 0.21.0, this is the release for you. Six PRs fix the root causes rather than the symptoms:

- **No more second writers.** Profile gateways wrote hosted-room state into the *root* `state.db` every 5 seconds; the dashboard opened a writable handle on startup; cron's lifecycle guard did a raw `open()` on a live database (which cancels the gateway's POSIX locks — the classic "how to corrupt SQLite" recipe); `doctor --fix` would checkpoint under a live holder. All four are gone: hosted rooms live in `shared-state.db`, the dashboard opens read-only first, the guard goes through the tracked connection registry, and `doctor --fix` refuses a checkpoint it can't prove is safe. (#108076 — salvage #103489 @RikETS, #102682 @JoaoMarcos44, #108012 @Halldrix, #105428 @TaoMasterCoder)
- **Healthy WAL databases stop wedging.** OpenZFS `(deleted)` dentries and a `close()` racing an `append_message` both produced a sticky `DeletedWalGenerationError` on a perfectly good store; the read pool was handed out under an unconfirmed journal mode; a transient `disk I/O error` on WSL2 killed `get_session` on the first attempt; and a "state.db locked" banner was broadcast after the lock had already cleared. (#108082 — salvage #107411 @chelsealong, #105578 @ca-shrimp, #105711 @gaoanze888, #106958 @nikkoxgonzales; co-authored @QDung210, @fangliquanflq, @Sahilvishnaliya)
- **FTS damage no longer kills your turn.** An error scoped to the full-text-search index was classified as whole-file corruption and fail-closed the conversation. It's now `fts_index`: search degrades, the index rebuilds later, the transcript store is untouched. Same PR: doctor names structural damage honestly instead of "FTS write corruption", the FTS write probe catches the stale-index shape that passed every check while every write failed, `.recover` output no longer fails startup on orphan FTS5 shadow tables, header-zeroed databases recover instead of being refused, and the dashboard analytics poller returns a 503 instead of 520K tracebacks a day. (#108130 — salvage #97843 @SulthanZahran1 + #97841 @Finn763, #88604 #56824 #103657 @liuhao1024, #106890 @nftpoetrist, #103321 @jangomango76, #91413 @leegunwoo98, #102808 @TaoMasterCoder)
- **One corrupt row no longer kills `sessions list`, export, or insights.** A TEXT timestamp or a `1e30` epoch used to crash the whole listing; malformed marker JSON crashed `json_extract`; more than 999 ids crashed bulk delete/prune. One `coerce_epoch()` helper on every reader (bad rows render `?` with a WARNING naming the session), a `json_valid` guard, IN-list chunking, and batched export hydration. (#108086 — salvage #106071 @Xipong, #101726 @efe-arv, #94701 @liuhao1024, #102679 @mssteuer, #100658 @Mi55ed)
- **Sessions never bind to or read another profile's database.** The Desktop launch backend could pin itself to the wrong profile's `state.db` under a HERMES_HOME override race; `session_search` by bare ID silently scanned every profile and returned someone else's transcript; recovery guidance pointed at the wrong file; profile delete kept a handle open (WinError 32). (#108074 — salvage #102534 @HexLab98, #106975 @Sora-bluesky)
- **Opening state.db no longer takes the write lock when nothing needs writing.** A one-shot `hermes` process opening the store behind a busy gateway stalled 4–20 s and then failed with "database is locked". Now 0.01 s. (#108067 — salvage #106751 @kshitijk4poor, #101881 @jonpol01)

Also in the window from the same subsystem: a fresh `state.db` no longer publishes FTS tables before owning the rebuild lock (#106311), a handle that lost its WAL generation no longer checkpoints stale frames at shutdown (#106315, #106840), a clobbered first page is quarantined with its WAL instead of opened destructively (#106587), WAL setup leaves an unverifiable database untouched (#106568), and quarantined handles refuse VACUUM/FTS optimize (#106343, #106349). Most of these salvaged community diagnoses by @kshitijk4poor.

### Multi-profile isolation hardening

A cluster of fixes for installs running several profiles under one gateway (multiplex): secondary-profile bots no longer inherit the default profile's allow-lists (#107616), adapters no longer send credentials to the default profile's host (#107617), stdio MCP servers no longer receive the default profile's vault secrets (#107630), `MEDIA:` delivery can no longer attach another profile's `.env` / `auth.json` / `state.db` (#107609), Feishu drive callbacks and `/p/<profile>/` webhook replies stay on the routed profile (#107620, #107626), and secondary profiles no longer get a sibling's Nous bearer from per-process memos (#107611).

### Desktop backend spawn storms are over

Bot Mode used to spawn or dial one backend per profile on launch and on every roster tick, hovering the Bots roster spawned a backend per row, and profile switches could spawn a duplicate primary. (#108069, #108107, #108118, #108134, #107969, #108112 — salvage #102512, #103634, #103399, #107997 and others by @kshitijk4poor)

### Password-blind credential vault

The agent can now sign in, pay, and fill addresses from 1Password, Bitwarden, or the local Hermes vault without ever seeing a secret; two-factor codes come from a saved authenticator key or are asked for in the user's UI (#106480, #107585). Private git plugins install with the user's stored credentials (#106981).

### Plugin catalog and one Plugins page

A curated, SHA-pinned plugin index with CLI, admission CI, docs and dashboard (#69446); Desktop gets one Plugins page owning agent + desktop plugins, install, catalog and per-commit pinning (#107212, #107314, #107321); Radio ships as an opt-in SDK plugin (#107072).

### Nous free tier and guided first launch

Free inference and connectors out of the box with one command to sign in (#105258, #105260), `/login` from a chat (#105261), connector tools (Gmail, Linear, Notion, ...) searchable through `tool_search` (#106842), and a guided first launch behind `HERMES_GUEST_ONBOARDING=1` (#107697, #107958, #107985, #108211).

## 🐛 Notable Bug Fixes

**Gateway & platforms**
- A bare `display:` key in config.yaml no longer crashes every gateway turn (#106305); a queued-lane final refused by the platform is recorded and redelivered (#106316); a stalled WebSocket send no longer blocks every later event (#106581); the first turn no longer waits on the Python toolchain probe (#106556).
- Telegram bots must @mention when `bots_require_mention` is on, breaking bot-to-bot loops (#106534); Matrix renders LaTeX (#106515); Signal renders markdown tables (#106538); WhatsApp replies to view-once messages keep their quote (#106541); media-only replies report SUCCESS everywhere (#106557).

**Providers & routing**
- `/model` and auxiliary auto never bill a provider you didn't select (#107366); never auto-switch to a provider you have no credentials for (#107281); Bedrock Claude/Converse/Mantle models survive `/model`, fallback and restore (#107621, #107658); Bedrock Guardrails enforced (#107815).
- Codex: patch-budget image 400 shrinks and retries (#106525); unentitled primary + fallback no longer oscillate (#106549); Azure Foundry replayed-reasoning rejection classified and pruned (#106718 @erosika). MCP OAuth refresh no longer erases the refresh token (#106185). Anthropic clients send exactly one credential (#107978).
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Nous Portal and OpenRouter pickers (#107489); GPT Image 2.5 via OpenAI and FAL (#105988); Opus 5 / Fable 5.1 on the native Anthropic picker (#106636 @xxxigm).

**Agent loop & compression**
- One blocked periodic callback no longer stalls lease refresh (#106308); a mid-turn `/steer` is persisted as its own user row (#106317, #106344); local-inference memory-ceiling rejections back off instead of compressing history (#106307); context-overflow after partial streaming ends the turn (#106567); length continuation stops when the prompt filled the window (#106571); compression no longer times out silently on aux retries (#106866); `model_thresholds` keys can be provider-scoped (#108061).
- Surface switch (Desktop↔TUI) no longer rebuilds the system prompt and busts the prompt cache (#105844); CLI keeps the `api_content` sidecar so the cache survives an early persist (#105842).

**CLI, TUI & Desktop**
- `hermes -z --resume` continues the session (#106313); Shift+letter and Cmd+Shift+Z work on extended-key terminals (#90674 @francip, #105493); `browser_exec` timeout kills the whole process tree (#106589); update checks poll the GitHub API once a day instead of git-fetching every 30 min (#107648); `hermes update` names the real cause and can't hang on a stalled fetch (#108053).
- Desktop: UI language survives the update relaunch (#106476), expired OAuth grants get a one-click re-sign-in (#106965), HUD mode shows the transcript again and always gives the window back (#107491, #107423), the backend exits when its Desktop parent dies (#107977), Windows updates stop reporting false failures (#106175, #107183), WSLg renders on the Windows GPU (#106528), Telegram quick setup with QR ported from the dashboard (#107242), and ~60 more Desktop fixes largely from @OutThisLife and @kshitijk4poor.

**Cron & Kanban**
- An off-tick "run now" no longer cancels the next scheduled run (#106306); a killed manual run no longer blocks the next one for 5 minutes (#106733); a one-shot changed to recurring keeps firing (#106532); unpinned jobs run on their creation-snapshot model (#106499); `--clone-all` no longer copies cron jobs (#106478); `kanban promote` refuses undone parents (#106550); `kanban_request_review` rejects unknown reviewer profiles (#106547).

**Tools & memory**
- A stdio MCP server dying mid-call no longer replays the tool call (#106546); a skills-only background review can no longer delete memory entries (#106310); mem0 memory no longer drops long turns (#106542); `tool_search` returns nothing rather than five tools sharing one word (#106676); remote NOPASSWD sudo no longer prompts (#107939); RSS and Reddit reading no longer activate by default (#105873).

**Housekeeping**
- `config.yaml` backups live in one bounded `backups/config/` dir (#106388); `hermes backup` keeps the newest 3 zips (#106455); `hermes setup --reset` backs up the real config (#106453); `debug share` retention shrunk to 1 day on the dpaste fallback (#106531).

## 👥 Contributors

Thank you to the **140 contributors** whose commits, co-author trailers, and salvaged PRs landed in this window.

**state.db campaign — salvaged PR authors:** @RikETS, @JoaoMarcos44, @Halldrix, @TaoMasterCoder, @chelsealong, @ca-shrimp, @gaoanze888, @nikkoxgonzales, @QDung210, @fangliquanflq, @Sahilvishnaliya, @kshitijk4poor, @jonpol01, @HexLab98, @Sora-bluesky, @Xipong, @efe-arv, @liuhao1024, @mssteuer, @Mi55ed, @SulthanZahran1, @Finn763, @nftpoetrist, @jangomango76, @leegunwoo98, @ggoldani.

**state.db campaign — issue reporters** (the forensics in these threads were often better than the fixes): @thedigitalcarpenterdad, @Rroven, @aoeman84, @StephanRosin, @rubensandrade-sketch, @wanliqin, @chenzheshushi-commits, @CarlosReyesPena, @revazone, @reservassai-art, @Cuttingwater, @soroush5, @e-shizz, @shobhit-87labs, @shivanathd, @hoelzl, @i8ei, @Ace-Kelly, @YinsenWANG, @zbabiarz, @Sravanjangam, @0gl20shk0sbt36, @RChina, @bronder, @ccwssy, @bottenbenny, and @Hitman117890 whose Discord report kicked the campaign off.

**Everyone in the window (alphabetical):** @0genlab, @0xalydev, @100yenadmin, @1052326311, @686f6c61, @69k4xmdfm2-blip, @abundantbeing, @Adolanium, @Ahmett101, @albert748, @AlexxRussell, @alt-glitch, @auroracapital, @austinpickett, @babatorik, @Bartok9, @benbarclay, @bennybuoy, @brian717, @briandevans, @buihongduc132, @ca-shrimp, @cervantesh, @Cesar-Azeredo, @ChanPark03, @chelsealong, @ckomma, @ClintonEmok, @crazyief, @ctaylor86, @dalzio, @DavidMetcalfe, @Drexuxux, @edosulai, @efe-arv, @emozilla, @ericmaddox, @erosika, @ethernet8023, @everm1nd, @FalconOrtiz, @fangliquanflq, @Finn763, @FirmamentalSpring, @francip, @g3org3yo, @gaoanze888, @ggoldani, @Halldrix, @haydster7, @hbizi, @helix4u, @HexLab98, @huklaa, @IAvecilla, @infinitycrew39, @jahfaliabdulrahman-dev, @jangomango76, @JoaoMarcos44, @jonpol01, @jwilson411, @KeyArgo, @kokhlo, @KoNit-K, @kshitijk4poor, @kyssta-exe, @leegunwoo98, @lesterlxt, @liuhao1024, @Mabolla, @manuelschipper, @MaxFreedomPollard, @mearls0501, @mengyuyuan, @Mi55ed, @MiseHinoha, @mjshorty, @mkrb84, @moisesvalero, @moken627-hub, @mssteuer, @nateEc, @nftpoetrist, @nickseelert, @nikkoxgonzales, @notwitcheer, @onuraycicek, @outdog-hwh, @OutThisLife, @philmossman, @phuongvm, @pierrenode, @portavales, @PRATHAMESH75, @QDung210, @rewbs, @RikETS, @romanovzky, @ryantuc, @Sahilvishnaliya, @salch-cred, @sgarrand, @shannonsands, @simpolism, @Solitud1nem, @somewheresy, @Sora-bluesky, @sprmn24, @squevo, @StellarisW, @Stoltemberg, @SulthanZahran1, @Svector-anu, @szicely, @TaoMasterCoder, @teknium1, @ten82e, @thedavidweng, @tkaufmann, @Totoro-qaq, @Tranquil-Flow, @tuancookiez-hub, @TurgutKural, @ugoenyioha, @unsupportedpastels, @victor-kyriazakos, @webtecnica, @wliu-dev, @wukangcheng1994, @Xipong, @Xixiartemis, @xkam7ar, @xxxigm, @yavarb, @yoniebans, @Youssef, @yoyodine-industries, @yuanchenglu, @YuhGuan, @Zeus-Deus.

releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.21.0 (v2026.8.31)

**Release Date:** August 31, 2026
**Since v0.20.0:** ~5,800 commits · ~2,475 merged PRs · ~5,680 files changed · ~869,000 insertions · ~135,000 deletions · **~2,100 issues closed** · 760+ contributors

> **The Pantheon Release.** v0.20.0 made Hermes the herald — he spoke, and he carried word to other agents. In v0.21.0 the gods assemble. Bot Mode ships built into the desktop app: a society of named agents with their own faces and group chats, where your bots talk to each other — and to you — like a team, not a toolbox. Around that spine: cron jobs gained memory and continuity so scheduled agents actually learn between runs, subagents can be steered live mid-flight, the MCP surface became a real command center, and the agent can now drive the desktop's own browser. This release rolls up everything from the v0.20.1–v0.20.6 infrastructure patch tags — those windows are fully documented here.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Bot Mode — your agents become a society, built in** — Bot Mode is now a bundled, default-on part of the desktop app: every agent profile gets a name, a deterministic avatar face (with randomize/lock controls), and a place in a shared roster. Create Discord-style group chats where multiple bots and you talk in one room, @-mention any bot from the composer, and give rooms names and pictures. Before, "multi-agent" meant plumbing; now it looks like a chat app full of coworkers. ([#87886](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87886), [#88243](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88243), [#89386](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/89386), [#96726](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/96726) — @teknium1, @OutThisLife, @dokterdok)

- **`hermes peer` — bot-to-bot DMs between your agents** — Any Hermes agent can now message any other by handle, across profiles and gateways, from the CLI or from inside a conversation. Ask your research bot to hand findings to your coding bot and get the reply back where you can read it. Replies land in each agent's canonical Bot Chat, so conversations between agents are durable and inspectable, not fire-and-forget. ([#88725](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88725), [#88178](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88178), [#91487](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/91487) — @teknium1)

- **Cron jobs that remember** — Scheduled jobs stopped being goldfish. Cron agents now load and update persistent memory like every other agent, `continuity=true` carries each run's output into the next (so a monitor can dedupe against what it already reported), every job gets a durable notepad scratchpad, monitor-mode jobs skip the LLM entirely when nothing changed, and cron output can land in a bot's canonical Bot Chat — where the bot actually responds. Your 9am briefing job now knows what it told you yesterday. ([#91447](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/91447), [#80774](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80774), [#81139](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81139), [#81138](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81138), [#91487](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/91487) — @teknium1, @smwbev)

- **Steer your subagents while they run** — `delegate_task` gained live orchestration: list running children, steer one mid-flight with a course correction, or stop it early and keep the partial result. Add optional JSON-schema validation on child outputs, per-delegation cost surfaced in results, and raised defaults (250 iterations, 10 concurrent children) — delegation went from fire-and-pray to actually managed parallel work. ([#85232](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85232), [#81144](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81144), [#81142](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81142), [#86506](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/86506), [#86745](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/86745) — @teknium1)

- **The MCP command center** — MCP servers and the catalog merged into one coherent desktop page with drag-in "paste anything" import, background health checks that nudge you to re-auth before a tool call fails, a fleet cost/usage overlay showing schema token estimates and 30-day usage per server, and `hermes://` deep links that install an MCP server with explicit confirmation. Managing twenty MCP servers used to be config-file archaeology; now it's a dashboard. ([#87525](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87525), [#87572](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87572), [#87576](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87576), [#87579](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87579), [#87581](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87581) — @teknium1)

- **A CLI power wave** — Ctrl+P opens a fuzzy command palette, the `/model` picker filters as you type, `/status` shows reasoning mode, pending approvals, and context usage, and the status bar can display live cache-hit %, latency, and tokens/sec with per-field toggles. Plus: a global emergency stop, session pin/unpin, rotating task-oriented composer placeholders — and Ghostty-level **terminal pets**, because a companion should have a companion. ([#90730](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/90730), [#90717](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/90717), [#90745](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/90745), [#98250](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/98250), [#98282](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/98282), [#97666](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97666) — @teknium1, and salvaged community work)

- **The agent drives the desktop's browser** — The in-app browser stopped being a window the agent could only look at: Hermes now navigates, clicks, and reads it directly, and pages can be popped out to your system browser with full link context menus. Ask it to walk a docs site or debug a web app and watch it happen inside your own app. ([#90197](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/90197), [#89366](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/89366) — @OutThisLife, @ethernet8023)

- **Six new providers and a model catalog wave** — Meta Model API (Muse Spark) arrives as a built-in provider, alongside CommandCode, Tencent TokenPlan, Nebius Token Factory, Ramp Router, and Actual Computer. The catalogs picked up GLM-5.3-Flash, qwen3.8-max/flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash, MiniMax M3 free, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning — and `model_overrides` lets you patch any model's context window or pricing yourself without waiting on a release. ([#88565](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88565), [#88308](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88308), [#97917](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97917), [#97916](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97916), [#97915](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/97915), [#85560](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85560) — @teknium1 and community)

- **Security hardening across the board** — Protected agent-instruction files (AGENTS.md, skills, memory stores) now always require write approval so a prompt-injected agent can't quietly rewrite its own standing orders. A deep redaction sweep closed secret-leak gaps across terminal errors, `.env` file reads, checkpoints, and ACP logs; the approval system learned Windows destructive commands; and macOS permission grants finally survive updates via a stable TCC signing identity. ([#81152](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81152), [#80965](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80965), [#84428](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/84428), [#95091](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/95091) — @teknium1 and community)

- **Per-model metadata overrides** via `model_overrides` config — patch context windows, pricing, or capabilities for any model without waiting on a release ([#85560](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85560)).
- **Data-training-tier warnings** — a unified selection-guard registry warns you across every picker surface when a model trains on your data ([#85917](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85917)).
- **Pip-installed model providers** discovered via entry points — third parties can ship providers as packages ([#85504](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85504), salvage #81419).
- **Prompt caching engaged for LiteLLM Claude** on the OpenAI wire ([#87517](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87517) — @kshitijk4poor) and api.meta.ai routed through the Responses API for caching ([#88601](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/88601)).
- **Codex GPT context defaults** back to the verified 272K, with explicit -900k picker variants for the large window ([#92797](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/92797)).

### Agent Loop & Reliability
- **Stalled-provider recovery** — a stalled stream no longer leaves Desktop silent or burns the retry budget ([#87236](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87236) — @fangliquanflq).
- **MoA hardening cluster** — the Mixture-of-Agents facade now survives client rebuilds, stream retries, provider rotation, and fallback/restore without leaking prepared requests to native clients ([#90212](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/90212) and siblings).
- **Structured-output resilience** — auxiliary calls translate `response_format` for Anthropic wires and retry when a provider rejects structured output ([#89589](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/89589) — @ethernet8023).
- **Compression: lean tail mode** + a compaction recall eval harness to measure what compression actually preserves ([#87326](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87326)).
- **Oversized tool results spill to cache** instead of being truncated in sandbox-less sessions ([#89028](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/89028)).
- **`clarify` asks multiple independent questions in one call** — one form instead of a chain of round-trips ([#89467](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/89467) — @ethernet8023).
- **Verify subsystem** (port from superagent-ai/grok-cli): run-recipe detection + environment manifest so "it works" claims are backed by detected build/test commands ([#80686](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80686)).

- **Instant session naming** from the opening message, with sticky titles across resume ([#81985](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81985) — @OutThisLife).
- **Session pin/unpin from the CLI** — durable keep flags ([#80761](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80761)).

releases.body:
# Hermes Agent v0.20.6 (v2026.8.27)

**Release Date:** August 27, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~525 PRs merged since v0.20.5 into a stable tagged release for downstream consumers (Docker images, hosted deployments, fresh installs).

---

## About this release

Since v0.20.5 (v2026.8.19, tagged August 21), this window landed **~1,313 commits** across **~1,557 files** (+177,113 / −21,682) — **~525 merged PRs** including consent-gated real-profile browsing (use your default Chromium profile for local browsing, with Windows close-with-approval flow); the desktop Browser getting its own OS window plus a managed SSH remote-update engine and fleet profile rail; a large remote MCP catalog expansion (50+ live-verified vendor-hosted servers incl. Cloudflare, Grafana Cloud, Better Stack, Railway); TTL result caching for web_search/web_extract; lean-tail compression as the default; multi-query tool_search with stemming; opt-in OS-keychain encryption for stored secrets (no more per-launch macOS Keychain prompts); updaters pausing gateways over the control socket instead of tree-killing them; image/package-managed installs refusing unsafe in-place updates (#91277 Phase 3); cron durable-incident acks and clearer code-skew failures; Slack link-unfurl controls; shared Docker container identities; pluggable terminal environment backends; and new models across the pickers (GLM-5.3-Flash, MiniMax M3 free, MiniMax H3 Max video).

**Full curated release notes for this window will ship with v0.21.0**, which will document everything from v0.20.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- `hermes update` from an existing install
- Fresh install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`

**Full Changelog**: [v2026.8.19...v2026.8.27](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v2026.8.19...v2026.8.27)
